national.name: NALSA (National Legal Services Authority)
national.description: Provides free legal aid to eligible citizens and coordinates State/District Legal Services Authorities across India.

national.name: Tele-Law
national.description: Free legal advice via video/telephone consultation with panel lawyers, run by the Department of Justice.

national.name: NyayaBandhu (Pro Bono Legal Services)
national.description: Connects eligible citizens with pro bono advocates registered with the Department of Justice.

national.name: eCourts Services
national.description: Official portal for case status, cause lists, and court information across District and High Courts. Advocate/case search requires completing a CAPTCHA on the official site.

national.name: National Commission for Women (NCW)
national.description: Complaints and legal guidance cell for women facing harassment, domestic violence, or workplace issues.

national.name: National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
national.description: Report cybercrime, including financial fraud and online harassment, directly to law enforcement.

national.name: Senior Citizens Helpline (Elder Line)
national.description: Support and legal guidance for senior citizens, including maintenance and property matters.

national.name: National Consumer Helpline
national.description: Assistance and guidance for consumer complaints before approaching the Consumer Commission (NCDRC).
